weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared entries@ and carrier portal logins; former Entry Writer's platform access lasted 19 days
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist; monthly reconciliation of every user list; entries@ converted to a shared mailbox with named access; named carrier portal users where offered
milestones: 2026-09-15 entries@ converted; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Office and Compliance Manager time (1 hour a month); MSP labor

weakness: No time limit for disabling access; shared passwords not changed; no confidentiality reminder at exit; CBP terminated-employee list sent on day 41
source: P07 (PS-04 objectives); P03 G-002, G-024; P01 R-005
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-001) including shared password changes, MFA removal, signed confidentiality reminder, signing authority withdrawal, and the CBP update within 10 days

weakness: Backup console and firewall management login accept a password only; entries@ excluded from MFA
remediation_plan: MSP enables MFA on the backup console and firewall with named technician accounts and sends screenshots; entries@ removed from the MFA exclusion when converted (POAM-001)

weakness: Shared passwords in a spreadsheet and in the printer; no refresh after departures; no number matching; printer default password (changed 2026-08-14)
source: P07 (IA-05 objectives, new finding on IA-05e.); P01 R-009, R-022
remediation_plan: Company password manager for shared portal logins; delete the spreadsheet; scan-only printer connector with its own restricted credential; number matching for MFA; printer added to patching and the inventory
milestones: 2026-08-14 printer password changed; 2026-09-30 number matching; 2026-10-31 password manager in use and spreadsheet deleted

weakness: No security or privacy training at hire or yearly; no phishing or payment fraud awareness
remediation_plan: Annual online training covering payment fraud, phishing, client confidentiality (111.24), AI rules, and the 72-hour CBP notice; quarterly phishing simulations; near-misses shared at the monthly staff meeting

weakness: Staff do not know how and when to report incidents or the 72-hour CBP notice
source: P07 interviews; P03 G-008; P01 R-004
remediation_plan: Reporting card at every desk (POL-03 4.2); CBP notice template and importer number data map; covered in training
milestones: 2026-09-30 cards posted; 2026-10-31 template and data map; 2026-10-31 training

weakness: Backup administrator login shared without MFA; storage region unknown; backup availability unproven; new paper POAs not scanned
remediation_plan: Named MSP accounts with MFA (POAM-003); confirm U.S. storage region; immutable retention if offered; scan paper POAs weekly after the 163.5 notice period
milestones: 2026-09-30 MFA; 2026-10-31 region confirmed and retention set
resources_required: MSP labor; possible plan change (within the funded suite upgrade)

weakness: No contingency plan testing; backup never restore-tested; no yearly records retrieval test
remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample folder and one full mailbox; quarterly restore tests recorded; yearly retrieval test of 20 records (163.5(b)(2)(iv)); annual tabletop with the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-10-31 first retrieval test; 2026-11-30 tabletop; 2026-12-31 second restore test

weakness: No security terms with the MSP; data regions unconfirmed; no client authorization for service providers; MSP questionnaire not returned
remediation_plan: Annual MSP security review with questionnaire and evidence; MSP contract terms for incident notice within 24 hours and 10-day breach notice; client terms clause drafted by counsel and sent to all active clients
milestones: 2026-10-31 MSP questionnaire; 2026-12-31 contract terms and client clause sent
resources_required: Owner and Office and Compliance Manager time; counsel fees (about $1,500, outside the P01 budget)

weakness: No review of sign-in alerts, forwarding rules, or platform access and export reports
remediation_plan: Monthly 30-minute review with a checklist (POL-02 B.11); suite alerts to the Office and Compliance Manager and the MSP; findings to the owner
resources_required: Office and Compliance Manager time (30 minutes a month)

weakness: No wipe or destruction record for 2 desktops replaced in 2025; wipe method undefined
remediation_plan: Written confirmation from the MSP of what happened to the 2 desktops; wipe standard and certificate required for every retired device

weakness: A message from a look-alike agent domain reached the Accounting Specialist with no warning
remediation_plan: External-sender tag; look-alike domain and impersonation protection for the owner and the Accounting Specialist (suite plan upgrade); payment call-back rule (POL-02 B.10) as the backstop
